blocks.text: INN NEWS - as a party dominates the government, the PDI of Gambling (PDIP) has a very influential effect in determining coalition shafts by 2024 elections. However, the PDIP this time tends to be calm and unhasty in determining political attitudes. Including in the PDIP talks that are joined in a major coalition.

This is also recognized by the Executive Director of Indonesian Survey Current, Ali Rif'an recently who said that PDIP already has a boarding pass to be able to install its own candidate in the 2024 election. For this reason, the PDIP is called unhasty in taking political decisions.
To have other parties manoeuvre in such a way that they should partner or coalition, while PDP is enough.
Even so, the PDIP doesn't necessarily close down political cry with other parties, including the ones that are joined in the great coalition.

The Chief of DPP PDI (PDIP) Said Abdullah had stated that communication with the Gerindra Party Prabou Subianto, the Golkar Airterga Hartarto Party Ketum PAN Zulkifli Hasan has been performed intensively by his colleague, Mrs. Maharani. That means, all choices are still very open to the PDIP.

The strategy of waiting and see ala PDIP

Candidates' engagement strategy at the 2024 election is not that different from previous elections. The PDIP still has his signature, which is to wait and see. And announce the political attitude at the end of elections or Pilates.

At the 2019 election, the PDIP always sticks with the answer to the presidential candidacy is the prerogative of General Chairman Megakarnodaughter Megawati. It's also balanced by intense political communication between PDIP and other parties like Golkar, PPP, Hanura, and others who are Jokowi supporters.

A similar political move seems to be done in the 2024 election. Although the PDIP is not yet present in a major coalition public meeting with President Jokowi (02 / 04), but Said Abdullah suppresses the supposition of the PDIP that does not communicate with other parties.
"We did that communication intensity in lobby-lobby lobes, private meetings forum with the ketum continues," clear Said at parliament complex, Tuesday (03 / 04).
Meanwhile, Megawati is called to have found out a major coalition discourse. Said also confirm in accordance with the Chairman's order that PDIP will keep the candidate from the internal party.
Said, PDIP is also ready to host big party-coalition parties. The politician of the Sudjatmiko Department in merena.com has basically stated that PDIP is okay with the coalition talk.

However, the political lobby after the coalition was established is still underway. Probation of capres to be charged, as well as any other political deal is thought to be an internal communication agenda in this coalition.
"The political cooperation that we hope to have together and become public attention, God willing, will not be achieved for long. It is better for you to say, if Allah wills.
The political observer of the National Research and Innovation Agency (BRIN) Wasisto Raharjo Jati in his opinion on CNN Indonesia says, PDIP's decision always comes as a surprise at the end.

If you look at these last years, the surprise of PDIP's political attitudes is an precision leading to a common PDIP victory. Will that happen at the 2024 election? Let's wait for the surprise together.
